workarounds.symptom: JSON loading retries indefinitely when a mixed-type field name contains a slash
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix mixed-type JSON fields with slashes in their names. Target files: src/datasets/packaged_modules/json/json.py, src/datasets/utils/json.py, tests/packaged_modules/test_json.py. cc @lhoestq (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/datasets/pull/8976)

Fix: fix(json): defensively recover invalid Arrow tables in JSON loader (#5531). Target files: src/datasets/packaged_modules/json/json.py, tests/packaged_modules/test_json.py. Adds defensive validation and recovery for malformed nested Arrow arrays returned by pyarrow.json.read_json(). When a batch produces invalid nested offsets, the JSON loader reparses only that batch row by row with pa.Table.from_pylist(), concatenates the rows while preserving late-arriving fields, validates the recovered table, and applies the configur... (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/datasets/pull/8521)

workarounds.symptom: IterableDataset.to_dict() and to_polars() return an empty generator instead of the data
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix default iterable dataset dict and polars exports. Target files: src/datasets/iterable_dataset.py, tests/test_iterable_dataset.py. . Picks up #8382 after [the original author handed it over](https://github.com/huggingface/datasets/issues/8381#issuecomment-[REDACTED]). The original fix is by @ebarkhordar. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/datasets/pull/8632)

workarounds.symptom: `IterableDataset.shuffle()` in 5.0 reports `num_shards = min(files per source)`, leaving DataLoader workers and distributed nodes without data
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Preserve source shards when shuffling iterable datasets. Target files: src/datasets/iterable_dataset.py, tests/test_distributed.py, tests/test_iterable_dataset.py. `IterableDataset.shuffle()` currently interleaves the source shards before node and DataLoader worker sharding. With 19 source shards and the default settings, the resulting dataset reports one shard, leaving three of four DataLoader workers idle. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/datasets/pull/8670)

workarounds.symptom: IterableDataset.filter fails with arrow, pandas and polars formats
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix IterableDataset.filter with arrow, pandas and polars formats. Target files: src/datasets/iterable_dataset.py, tests/test_iterable_dataset.py. `IterableDataset.filter` raised for every table format (`arrow`, `pandas`, `polars`), although the integration guides say it works the same way as `IterableDataset.map`. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/datasets/pull/8725)

workarounds.symptom: Casting `large_string` / `string_view` to ClassLabel fails, so `Dataset.from_pandas(df, features=ClassLabel)` breaks with pandas 3
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix Json.cast_storage double-encoding large_string and string_view columns. Target files: src/datasets/features/features.py, tests/features/test_features.py. `Json.cast_storage` only treats a `pa.StringArray` as already holding JSON text. `large_string` and `string_view` arrays are not subclasses of it, so they fall through to the generic branch and every value gets JSON-encoded a second time. The column then decodes back to plain strings instead of objects, and no error is raised. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/datasets/pull/8682)

workarounds.symptom: Errror when saving to disk a dataset of images
workarounds.workaround: Fix: don't embed remote files in download_and_prepare to parquet. Target files: src/datasets/arrow_writer.py, src/datasets/features/audio.py, src/datasets/features/image.py. fix the viewer at https://huggingface.co/datasets/raivn/vn-test/discussions/1 kinda related: https://github.com/huggingface/datasets/issues/5717 (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/datasets/pull/8150)
